readerCopy.headline: A sudden change on someone else's side can rewrite your plan.
readerCopy.body:
A client changes the terms. Someone moves. An institution changes a rule. A schedule that used to be reliable suddenly is not. The change may have nothing to do with you and still require you to make different arrangements very quickly.

Jupiter opposing Uranus can make the consequences of someone else's change spread fast. Adapt to what actually changed, not every possibility your mind can generate from it. One new condition may require one new plan, not a complete reinvention of your life.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a breakup, job loss, relocation, conflict, or that another person's change is intentional.
